title: Prometheus system: brain-neural interface built from a psychic child's brain waves

tellings.quote: what they were trying to do is build a brain neural interface, right?

plain: A man named Jordan, who says he was taken into a UFO programme as a child, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that around 2008 to 2010, at a children's services organisation in New York called Baker Victory Services, people were working on something called the Prometheus system. He says they were trying to build a brain neural interface, a link between a brain and a machine, using the brain waves of a child said to be psychic. If true, it would mean someone was turning claimed psychic ability into technology.
